taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Tigidam-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1148 | 3.21 | 3.21
2 | 2087 | 11.9 | 15.12
3 | 808 | 16.8 | 32
4 | 1896 | 68.5 | 100
5 | 4854 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Tigidam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KQH
Aquifer depth: 15.12 m – 32 m (Layer 3, low-resistivity zone interpreted as saturated sand/sandstone)
Recommendation: Target the main water-bearing zone between approximately 15 m and 32 m depth; case and grout the upper overburden (0–15 m) to prevent collapse and contamination, and set screens within the 15.12–32 m interval to optimize yield.
